title: Quantifying the proportion of different cell types in the human cortex using DNA methylation profiles
authors: Hannon E; Dempster EL; Chioza B; Davies JP; Blake GE; Burrage J; Policicchio S; Franklin A; Walker EM; Bamford RA; Schalkwyk LC; Mill J
one_liner_zh: 该文利用DNA甲基化谱估算人脑皮层细胞类型比例，属于表观遗传学细胞去卷积分析，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作、转录因子结合或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract:
Background

Due to inter-individual variation in the cellular composition of the human cortex, it is essential that covariates that capture these differences are included in epigenome-wide association studies using bulk tissue. As experimentally derived cell counts are often unavailable, computational solutions have been adopted to estimate the proportion of different cell-types using DNA methylation data. Here, we validate and profile the use of an expanded reference DNA methylation dataset incorporating two neuronal- and three glial-cell subtypes for quantifying the cellular composition of the human cortex.

Results

We tested eight reference panels containing different combinations of neuronal- and glial-cell types and characterized their performance in deconvoluting cell proportions from computationally reconstructed or empirically-derived human cortex DNA methylation data. Our analyses demonstrate that these novel brain deconvolution models produce accurate estimates of cellular proportions from profiles generated on postnatal human cortex samples, they are not appropriate for the use in prenatal cortex or cerebellum tissue samples. Applying our models to an extensive collection of empirical datasets, we show that glial cells are twice as abundant as neuronal cells in the human cortex and identify significant associations between increased Alzheimer’s disease neuropathology and the proportion of specific cell types including a decrease in NeuNNeg/SOX10Neg nuclei and an increase of NeuNNeg/SOX10Pos nuclei.

Conclusions

Our novel deconvolution models produce accurate estimates for cell proportions in the human cortex. These models are available as a resource to the community enabling the control of cellular heterogeneity in epigenetic studies of brain disorders performed on bulk cortex tissue.
abstract_zh:
背景

由于人类大脑皮层细胞组成存在个体间差异，在使用批量组织进行的表观基因组关联研究中，纳入捕捉这些差异的协变量至关重要。由于实验获得的细胞计数往往不可用，已采用计算方法利用DNA甲基化数据来估算不同细胞类型的比例。在此，我们验证并概述了使用一个扩展的参考DNA甲基化数据集，该数据集包含两种神经元和三种胶质细胞亚型，用于量化人类大脑皮层的细胞组成。

结果

我们测试了八个包含不同神经元和胶质细胞类型组合的参考面板，并表征了它们在从计算重建或经验推导的人类大脑皮层DNA甲基化数据中解卷积细胞比例的性能。我们的分析表明，这些新型大脑解卷积模型能从出生后人类皮层样本生成的谱图中产生准确的细胞比例估计，但它们不适用于产前皮层或小脑组织样本。将我们的模型应用于大量经验数据集，我们显示人类大脑皮层中胶质细胞的数量是神经元细胞的两倍，并识别出阿尔茨海默病神经病理学增加与特定细胞类型比例之间的显著关联，包括NeuNNeg/SOX10Neg细胞核减少和NeuNNeg/SOX10Pos细胞核增加。

结论

我们的新型解卷积模型能对人类大脑皮层中的细胞比例产生准确估计。这些模型作为资源提供给社区，使得在批量皮层组织进行的脑疾病表观遗传学研究中能够控制细胞异质性。
